```{r}
#| include: false

## Research page ("Night and Day" design): intro and theme index, five theme
## sections (a featured study, then "More from this theme" cards), then the
## navy "How we work" card (methods, R packages, package downloads). Built from
## Pandoc markdown that the chunks below cat(); styles are in styles/bml.scss
## and styles/bml-research.scss.
##
## The themes come from a frozen snapshot made by sync_research.R (see
## CLAUDE.md): this page reads only research/research.json and
## research/figures/, never the wiley_cv analysis. The figures are published
## through `resources:` above; research.json is not.

## load packages and setup
source("package_setup.R", echo = FALSE)

research <- readResearch()

## downloads of all the lab's R packages (more than the listed ones), rounded
## down: "Our 8 R packages have been downloaded >970,000 times (Posit CRAN
## mirror, as of October 2026)."; left out if the workbook has none. It names
## the mirror as the source but doesn't claim the packages are on CRAN
## (Joshua, 2026-10-09).
downloads <- getDownloads()

## a text card in place of a figure, for papers with no picked figure: the
## plain-language finding. A trial protocol has no results yet, so its card is
## a "Study plan".
textCardMd <- function(p, classes = "") {
  sprintf("::: {.bml-textcard%s}\n[%s]{.bml-eyebrow}\n\n[%s]{.bml-textcard-text}\n:::\n",
          classes, if (identical(p$design, "Trial protocol")) "Study plan" else "Key finding",
          mdEscape(p$finding))
}

## the featured study: figure (linked to the full-size image) and credit left,
## the finding, citation and "Read the paper" right; only the first theme's
## figure loads straight away
featureMd <- function(p, lazy) {
  left <- if (!is.null(p$figure)) {
    sprintf("::: {.bml-plate-figure}\n%s\n\n%s\n:::\n", paperFigureMd(p, lazy), paperCredit(p))
  } else {
    sprintf("::: {.bml-plate-figure}\n%s:::\n", textCardMd(p))
  }
  sprintf('
::: {.bml-plate .bml-plate-flat .bml-feature}
%s
::: {.bml-plate-caption}
[Featured study]{.bml-eyebrow}

[%s]{.bml-finding}

[%s (%s). %s. *%s*.]{.bml-cite}

[Read the paper](%s){.bml-btn aria-label="Read the paper: %s"}
:::
:::
', left, mdEscape(p$summary), mdEscape(paperAuthor(p)), p$year,
    mdEscape(sub("\\.$", "", p$title)), mdEscape(p$journal),
    paperDoi(p), attrEscape(p$title))
}

## a representative paper: figure thumbnail (or a text card with the
## plain-language finding), why it's here, one line naming the paper, and the
## link. With a figure that line is its credit ("Figure 2 reproduced from Tung
## et al. (2022), *Scientific Reports*."), which already gives the citation;
## a text card gets the citation ("Sanjivini et al. (2025). *Sleep Advances*.").
paperCardMd <- function(p) {
  top <- if (!is.null(p$figure)) {
    sprintf("::: {.bml-card-media}\n%s\n:::\n", paperFigureMd(p))
  } else {
    textCardMd(p, " .bml-card-media")
  }
  source <- if (!is.null(p$figure)) paperCredit(p) else sprintf(
    "[%s (%s). *%s*.]{.bml-cite}", mdEscape(paperAuthor(p)), p$year, mdEscape(p$journal))
  sprintf('
::: {.bml-card .bml-card-flush .bml-paper-card}
%s
::: {.bml-card-body}
%s

%s

[Read the paper\\ [→]{aria-hidden="true"}](%s){.bml-link aria-label="Read the paper: %s"}
:::
:::
', top, mdEscape(p$why), source, paperDoi(p), attrEscape(p$title))
}
```

::: {.column-screen .bml-band .bml-research-intro}

[`r mdEscape(research$intro)`]{.bml-intro}

Our team is led by Dr Joshua Wiley and sits within the
[School of Psychological Sciences](https://www.monash.edu/medicine/psych/)
and the [Turner Institute for Brain and Mental Health](https://www.monash.edu/turner-institute)
at Monash University, in the Sleep and Circadian Rhythms Program.

[Research themes]{.bml-eyebrow .bml-muted}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## the themes as a list, each linked to its section below
cat(paste(vapply(research$themes, function(t) sprintf(
  "- [[%s]{.bml-theme-index-name}](#%s)",
  mdEscape(t$title), t$anchor), ""), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```
:::
:::
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## one section per theme: short-name eyebrow, title and blurb, the
## featured study, then the other papers in a row (a swipe row on phones).
## The section id is the theme's anchor (#stress, #sleep, ...), which the
## home page's theme cards link to.
for (i in seq_along(research$themes)) {
  t <- research$themes[[i]]
  cat(sprintf('
::: {#%s .column-screen .bml-band .bml-theme-band}
::: {.grid .bml-gap-lg .bml-theme-head}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}
[%s]{.bml-eyebrow .bml-muted}

## %s
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}
%s
:::
:::
%s
::: {.bml-more}
### More from this theme {#%s-more}
:::

::: {.bml-rail role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="More papers: %s"}
%s
:::
:::
',
    t$anchor, mdEscape(t$short), mdEscape(t$title), mdEscape(t$blurb),
    featureMd(t$exemplar, lazy = i > 1), t$anchor, attrEscape(t$title),
    paste(vapply(t$representatives, paperCardMd, ""), collapse = "\n")))
}
```

[Free R packages from the lab]{.bml-eyebrow}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat("::: {.bml-chips}\n",
    paste(sprintf("[%s](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=%s){.bml-chip .bml-mono}",
                  unlist(research$software), unlist(research$software)), collapse = " "),
    "\n:::\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(downloads)) cat(sprintf(
  "\n[Our %d R packages have been downloaded \\>%s times (Posit CRAN mirror%s).]{.bml-meta}\n",
  downloads$packages, fmtNum(belowRound(downloads$total, 10000)),
  if (is.na(downloads$asOf)) "" else paste(", as of", format(downloads$asOf, "%B %Y"))))
```
